preconditions.description: Attacker must hold at least numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity (500,000 * 10^6 * 10^18) of the PLENTYCOIN token
Contract must have accumulated enough tokens from fees to trigger swapAndLiquify (balanceOf(address(this)) - _lockedAmount >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity)

exploit_hint: Trigger the swapAndLiquify() function by making a transfer that causes contractTokenBalance >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity. The vulnerable transfer(_buyBackAddress, rest) call in swapAndLiquify() will use msg.sender (attacker) as the transfer source instead of the contract address, causing the attacker's tokens to be sent to _buyBackAddress while the contract's tokens remain untouched. This allows the attacker to steal tokens from the contract's accumulated fee balance.
